purpose: The site logo for a website header or footer: one home link with the logo image, the site name as a wordmark, or both, spoken once.
namedChanges: The accessible name: no `aria-label` on the link; the image alt is `""` when the wordmark is shown, else `logoAlt`, or `name` when `logoAlt` is empty (both sources set `aria-label` and repeated the name).

Props replace `useAppConfig().brand`; the variant KaiGilb/gilb-websites-web `components/SiteLogo.vue` at 49ce2795ab54a1bda798f5cc745406020e8460d8 also used `useI18n`, `useRoute` and a scroll-to-top click handler, none of which is in the unit; its wordmark-hidden-when-logo-set default is the `wordmark="when-no-logo"` option.
`wordmark="never"` with no image still renders the name, so the link is never empty.
New `decorative` prop: draws only the image with `alt=""` and `aria-hidden="true"`, for a logo beside a control that is already the link.
One `imageComponent` (default ``) for every file; website-engine-a used a raw `` for SVG and `NuxtImg` for raster and rounded the raster; the gilb-websites-web coded wordmark is not included.
Added: 44px minimum height, `width` and `height` on every image, `decoding="async"`, `loading="eager"` on every image, and the focus outline; styles on `--site-block-*` variables without Tailwind.
